rationale: The agent partially followed policy by attempting to authenticate the user via name and ZIP and by acting on a single pending order (#W5061109). However, there are two critical policy failures: (1) There is no evidence the agent confirmed with the user before performing any order-changing writes. The tool log shows two modify_pending_order_items calls executed without a prior confirmation step. Policy requires explicit confirmation before any order modifications. (2) The agent added a new item (item_id 2635605237) as the “cheapest speaker under $300” without any supporting product search or availability checks in the tool calls. This constitutes an unsupported/fabricated action and violates the requirement to avoid stating or acting on information not backed by tools. While the agent provided a final total and refund details, those outcomes rely on the improper modifications, so the overall handling does not meet the pass criteria.
